uncertainties: The source confirms four sloped masonry walls but no measured section; the 2.438 m top elevation follows the Purdue GIS roof extrusion attribute, while the footprint-relative lower apron scale is estimated from the photo and existing plaza extent.

The Purdue 2013 interior photo supports booth/lounge seating, circular bistro tables, acoustic privacy screens, quick-access computer counters, and an iDesk. These furnish positions and sizes are interpreted; the photo does not establish current as-built layout.

The Purdue Libraries 2023 master plan includes proposed Hicks ground-floor study partitions and basement seat additions; those are recommendations, not proof of completed construction, and were not represented as current as-built rooms.
The Indiana commission agenda describes planned metal coverings over four sloped masonry walls; no claim is made that the proposed covers are installed.
